title: Syndiospecific polymerization of styrene with half-titanocene catalysts containing fluorinated phenoxy ligands
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10711-10716
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00389J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bin Wu, Qingyu Zhang, Hongyu Liu, Tongtong Zhang, Xiaolong Yang, Fangming Zhu
Novel half-titanocene catalysts containing fluorinated phenoxy ligands were synthesized and used for the syndiotactic polymerization of styrene in the presence of low methylaluminoxane (MAO) and triisobutylaluminum (TIBA) as cocatalysts.
